parsed.name: ensemble_dual_lens_biotech_power_semis
parsed.strategy: Only names at least two lenses would pick. Biotech PDUFA sleeve (VRTX, MRK, GILD, ARGX, AGIO, COGT, BBIO, SMMT) is chosen by catalysts plus revision flow: every one has a dated FDA decision or print inside six months and net-positive analyst target actions. Power and semis sleeve (GEV, NVT, ASML, TSM) is chosen by power_grid plus revision flow: inflection flags, double-digit revenue growth, and near-unanimous raises into confirmed October earnings. AME, WST, RGEN are quality-momentum plus revision-flow names. I am wrong if a CRL cluster hits the PDUFA sleeve, or if AI capex digestion cuts semicap orders and grid backlog at once.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return versus SPY, net of costs, holding only names two independent lenses both select.

strategy.brief: Ensemble: only names that at least TWO of the other lenses (power, catalysts, revision flow, policy, quality momentum, Asia supply chain) would pick. Say which two for each name. Personal book: long only, 6-month horizon (126 sessions), no per-name cap, declare cash explicitly (0 is a declaration), graded net of costs against SPY.
